intro: Set up packages for each service (Economy, Standard, Premium): the sale price and the executors’ work. The manager picks a package in the proposal; once the proposal is accepted, a cost plan for executors is created in the project automatically.
noServices: Add services in Reference data first
name: Package name
descriptionHint: Goes into the proposal line item description
itemsText: Piece rate — work × quantity at the executor’s rate (e.g. 8 reels by a videographer). Fixed — an amount per project (e.g. a web developer’s salary).
label: Label (optional)
title: Packages

errors.itemRequired: Piece rate — select the work; fixed — select the executor and amount
errors.pricePositive: Price must be greater than zero

workItemsText: Default piece price per unit. Personal rates are set in the employee profile.
